limitations: Land-cover change and slope are conditioning factors, not a calibrated probability of slope failure
No soil erodibility, soil depth, pore pressure, geotechnical validation or exposure model
Compare seasonally equivalent periods; class probabilities are uncertain
Coverage below80percent blocks interpretation; zero candidate area does not prove absence of risk
No RUSLE soil-loss estimate: rainfall erosivity/K/LS/C/P not calibrated
CHIRPS rainfall is regional context at5566m within6km of AOI centre, not parcel rainfall or erosivity
